reviews.title: Great Price/TB
reviews.comment: Incredible value when compared with available NZ retail options. Purchased 3 drives, all secured in anti-static bags and foam surround. No issue using with TrueNAS.
reviews.author: Cameron

reviews.title: Great drive, worked immediately, good value for the money comparatively.
reviews.comment: The main downside of this item is that it only has a 3 year warranty instead of the 5 year warranty that comes with a new device. Of course, the upside is that it’s actually priced affordable, right now computer component prices are stupid high, especially for the larger capacity units like this. Easily slotted it into my QNAP NAS as a replacement for another drive, and the NAS recognized it immediately and started the array rebuild.
reviews.author: Derek Moyes

reviews.title: Great quality Drives
reviews.comment: Drives came in with no issues in good condition, SMART showed no issues, slid right in, survived a gruelling 4 day stress test with no errors. Prices have hiked as everything else these days but these hold up very well.
